name: MEA Local — Extracted Inventory Service (Quarkus)
_comment: FORWARD-REFERENCE (inventory-plan.md S5+, not yet exercised by S2): points the SAME behavior-equivalence suite at the extracted Quarkus Inventory service (examples/04-inventory-service/) once it exists, on its own port so it can run side-by-side with the monolith during the strangler cutover. Only the Inventory Context Contract folder is meaningful against this target until the order->inventory gRPC seam (inventory-plan S6/S7) and the proxy's strangler.inventory.enabled flag (S9/S10) are wired — Scenario 1-3 (the load-bearing cross-seam inventory-mutation checks) only go green here once checkout itself routes reserve/release through the extracted service. The collection itself must NOT change (that is the equivalence gate, DRQ-014); update `baseUrl` here (and/or point it at the Camel strangler proxy's inventory route) once S9/S10 stand the cutover up.
